title: When Does In-Context Learning Emerge, and Does It Endure? Code, logs, and model weights
description: Code, configurations, and the raw evaluation logs of all 227 training runs behind the study When Does In-Context Learning Emerge, and Does It Endure? Evidence from Small Transformers (Maikel Leon, University of Miami Business School), together with the final weights of the 77 runs added in the revision, the checkpoints of its instrumented runs, and the script and per-prompt outputs of a probe of in-context regression across the pretraining checkpoints of the Pythia language models. Small decoder-only transformers are trained from scratch on finite pools of synthetic regression tasks, and every run is measured against exact reference predictors for memorization and in-context learning. The analysis scripts regenerate every figure and table of the manuscript from the logs.
